title: Finite-free degree-zero cycle presentation for the Picard H1 argument
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $f_i:X_i\to S$, indexed by $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$, be flat proper morphisms locally of finite presentation [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], with $u_i:X_i\to X$ satisfying $u_i f=f_i$. Assume that after every base change their canonical tensor-pullback adjunction units on the structure module are isomorphisms [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-module-pullback, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $L$ be invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], $k:W\to S$ an immersion, $w\in W$, $s=k(w)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Assume that each $u_i^*L$ after base change to $W$ descends from a finite locally free module on $W$, and $L$ on $X_s$ descends from a finite locally free module on $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Assume joint injectivity on structure-sheaf $H^1$ at $s$ [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback]. Put $Y=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(w)$ and $L_Y$ for the tensor pullback of $L$. There exist an open $U\subset W$ containing $w$, integers $m,q\geq0$, a vector $d\in\Gamma(W,U)^m$, and a linear map $b:\Gamma(W,U)^m\to\Gamma(W,U)^q$, such that for the prime $p=\ker(\Gamma(W,U)\to\kappa(w))$ the map $b\otimes\kappa(p)$ is injective and $b(d)=0$. There also exists an additive equivalence $c:\Gamma(Y,L_Y)\simeq\kappa(w)$ with this cycle-realization property: for every open $V\subset U$ containing $w$, there is $j:Y\to X_V=X\times_S V$ hitting every point above $w$, and $e:j^*L_V\cong L_Y$, such that every scalar $a\in\Gamma(W,V)$ satisfying $(d_i|_V)a=0$ for every $i$ gives a global section $\sigma$ of $L_V$ whose canonical adjunction-unit restriction along $j$, transported by $e$, is $c^{-1}(a(w))$. Neither vanishing of $d$ near $w$ nor lifting arbitrary residue scalars is part of this conclusion.

proof.text: Choose the standard derived localizations of the module categories, and apply the local-model theorem to obtain U,K,e0,e1,hE,d,b and the comparison square alpha,beta. The evaluation kernel is prime by Mathlib RingHom.ker_isPrime.

Prove injectivity of b tensor kappa(p). If its values on x,y agree, apply beta and the comparison square to see that every structure H-one pullback of alpha(x) and alpha(y) agrees. Apply hH, then alpha.injective, to obtain x=y. This argument applies also to the empty family and zero rank.

Apply the fixed-model cycle realization theorem to U,K,e0,e1,hE,d. It gives c, j, e and the section comparison for every smaller V. The coordinate hypotheses d_i restricted times a=0 imply the vector equation a times restricted d=0 by function extensionality and commutativity. Use that equation in the realization theorem and assemble the asserted witnesses.

theorem picard_h1_base_descent_cycle_presentation {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) {n : ℕ}
    (Xi : Fin n → Scheme.{v}) (fi : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [∀ i, Flat (fi i)] [∀ i, IsProper (fi i)] [∀ i, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (fi i)]
    (ui : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X) (hui : ∀ i, ui i ≫ f = fi i)
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (hOi : ∀ i, ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd (fi i) g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) [IsImmersion k]
    (w : W) (s : S) (hw : k w = s)
    (hLi : ∀ i, ∃ (N : W.Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (fi i) k)).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (ui i)).obj L) ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (fi i) k)).obj N))
    (hLs : ∃ (N : (Spec (S.residueField s)).Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj L ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj N))
    (hH : Function.Injective (fun x :
        Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))) 1 ↦ fun i ↦
      structureSheafCohomologyPullback
        (((Over.pullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).map
          (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (fi i)) (V := Over.mk f) (ui i) (hui i))).left) 1 x)) :
    ∃ (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (m q : ℕ)
      (d : Fin m → Γ(W, U))
      (b : (Fin m → Γ(W, U)) →ₗ[Γ(W, U)] (Fin q → Γ(W, U))),
      let p := RingHom.ker (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
      ∃ hp : p.IsPrime,
        (letI := hp; Function.Injective (b.baseChange p.ResidueField)) ∧ b d = 0 ∧
      ∃ c : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback
          (pullback.fst f (W.fromSpecResidueField w ≫ k))).obj L, ⊤) ≃+
            W.residueField w,
        ∀ (V : W.Opens) (hwV : w ∈ V) (hVU : V ≤ U),
          ∃ j : pullback f (W.fromSpecResidueField w ≫ k) ⟶ pullback f (V.ι ≫ k),
            (∀ x : (pullback f (V.ι ≫ k) : Scheme.{v}),
              (pullback.snd f (V.ι ≫ k)) x = (⟨w, hwV⟩ : V.toScheme) →
                ∃ y, j y = x) ∧
            ∃ e : (Modules.tensorPullback j).obj
                ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ k))).obj L) ≅
                (Modules.tensorPullback
                  (pullback.fst f (W.fromSpecResidueField w ≫ k))).obj L,
              ∀ a : Γ(W, V),
                (∀ i, W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (d i) * a = 0) →
                ∃ σ : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ k))).obj L, ⊤),
                  e.hom.app ⊤
                    (((Modules.tensorPullback j).obj
                      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ k))).obj L)).presheaf.map
                        (homOfLE j.preimage_top.ge).op
                          (((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
                            ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ k))).obj L)).val.app
                              (Opposite.op ⊤) σ)) =
                    c.symm (W.evaluation V w hwV a)
